# Roleplay Character Guidelines

## Creating Authentic Characters

- Base motivations on realistic human needs
- Consider economic and social constraints
- Research actual professions and activities
- Include personal relationships and dependencies

## Character Development Tips

- Start with core motivation (what drives them?)
- Add personal stakes (what do they have to lose?)
- Include daily mundane details for realism
- Consider how their work affects their family life

## Common Character Archetypes

- The Reluctant Criminal: Driven by necessity
- The Family Provider: Sacrificing for loved ones
- The Skilled Worker: Using talents in gray areas
